messages:
nora: shared a prototype for the 'rollout nudge' overlay when users change min/max or enable burst. wants quick eyes on wording + accessibility. figma: https://figma.com/file/rollout-nudge

jiang: overall looks good. two quick UX questions: does this overlay block action or is it informative only? the copy sounds modal-ish.

nora: it's non-blocking; the idea is to nudge users to preview impact before committing. CTA still 'Apply changes'. overlay has 'Preview impact' and 'Apply anyway'.

samir: copy tweak: current header 'Potential impact' is vague. suggest 'Estimated impact on throughput & cost' to be explicit.

maya: accessibility: overlay appears after you change value, but there's no aria-live announcement. keyboard users won't know the preview updated. need aria-live polite with short text.

accessibility-bot: auto-lint: issues: color contrast of small delta tag fails AA; overlay not focus-trapped; preview chart is not described for screen readers.

nora: good catches. I'll update the tag color and add a focus trap. For the chart, thinking of a short SR summary: "Throughput expected +25% · Cost estimate +9% · Expected swap delay 10–30s".

jiang: about the SLO slider: what happens if the user's target SLO is unattainable on the selected pool? we should surface a clear suggestion: "Incompatible with selected pool  Try enabling burst or pick a higher-tier pool." maybe a subtle inline badge.

samir: prefer inline badge with text + link. triangles can be missed. also show a 'Why this matters' microcopy on hover explaining throughput vs latency tradeoff.

maya: keyboard flow: when the preview opens, focus should go to the primary action 'Preview impact' so a keyboard user can press Enter. currently focus remains in the SLO slider which is confusing.

nora: agreed. other small thing: deep-linking — can we add ?preview=true to the URL when overlay is open so designers can share states? QA needs this.

accessibility-bot: reminder: provide SR-friendly number formats. avoid '12%' alone; use 'twelve percent' in the offscreen text.

nora: action list: 1) change header to 'Estimated impact on throughput & cost', 2) add aria-live summary and SR-friendly text, 3) focus trap and set initial focus on 'Preview impact', 4) swap delta tag color to pass AA, 5) add inline incompatibility badge with link + microcopy, 6) append ?preview=true when open. I'll push updated frame as 2109804332.

jiang: quick visual ask: consider a small 'thermometer' vertical indicator showing headroom (green/yellow/red) next to pool selector so users get an at-a-glance sense of fit.

samir: +1 but ensure color isn't the only cue; add text 'Headroom: 60% (sufficient)'.

maya: sounds great. i'll run a focused a11y check after the update. thanks all :sparkles:
